map.估算累计花费：输入单包价格与每日吸烟量，按 365 天/年累加，直观看到 1/5: Estimate cumulative spending: enter the price per pack and daily consumption, accumulate over 365 days a year, and see the 1, 5, 10, and 20 year totals at a glance.

map.对比健康隐性成本：除直接烟钱外，吸烟相关疾病的医疗、误工等隐性成本更高，本工具聚: Compare hidden health costs: beyond the direct cost of cigarettes, the medical and lost-work costs of smoking-related illness are much higher, while this tool focuses on directly quantifiable monetary savings.

map.只算烟钱会不会低估危害？: Does Counting Only the Cost of Cigarettes Understate the Harm?
map.会的。烟草相关肺病、心血管病的医疗与误工成本远超烟钱本身，且健康损失难以用金钱衡: Yes. The medical and lost-work costs of tobacco-related lung and cardiovascular disease far exceed the cost of the cigarettes, and the health damage is hard to put a price on. This tool quantifies only the directly computable spending savings.
map.戒烟有什么省钱之外的好处？: What Benefits Does Quitting Bring Beyond Saving Money?
map.嗅觉味觉恢复、心肺功能改善、皮肤与牙齿变好、家人免受二手烟危害，并显著降低多种慢: Smell and taste recover, cardiorespiratory function improves, skin and teeth improve, family members avoid secondhand smoke, and the risk of many chronic diseases drops significantly. The earlier you quit, the greater the benefit.
